newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures close firmer, buoyed by U.S. heat.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures close firmer, buoyed by U.S. heat.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures staged a modest recovery from the day's lows on Friday and closed firmer as refined oil products markets in the U.S. strengthened, traders said.

IPE December Brent closed at $24.22 a barrel, 47 cents up from Thursday, after breaking through resistance at $24.05 towards the close. November IPE gas oil closed earlier just 75 cents a tonne firmer at $224.50.
"It is modestly firmer but dogged by low volume," one dealer said.

"A slight recovery in gasoline has helped, but most of the market has been watching heating oil moving higher. We did get rid of some of yesterday's weakness when (heating oil) poked its head above yesterday's highs, and the general appearance is firmer," he added. "But it has been very quiet and volumes have been low."

Dealers said news that Star Enterprise would shut a 15,000 barrel per day hydrocracker at its 235,000 bpd refinery in Texas, for an unplanned repair, had helped lift gasoline prices a little off the day's lows.
Mike Killien, manager of the refinery, said he expected the hydrocracker to be down "for 10 days to two weeks."
November NYMEX unleaded gasoline stood at 70.15 cents a gallon, 0.93 cents firmer at 1919 GMT. Heating oil had gained 1.31 cents and was trading at 71.80.
